styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh fruit-flavored supplement ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm cream #FDF4E6, charcoal text #2D2D2D, citrus orange accent #F08A3C, and soft leaf green #A8C948 for icon dots; warm bright tone; modern rounded sans-serif with short 「」-wrapped headlines only; clean white and warm cream backgrounds with fresh fruit accents; bright high-key soft studio lighting with gentle shadows and soft contact shadows; rounded-corner info cards with orange pill section headers and circular fruit photo medallions; consistent thin-line icons with circular photo chips; stable centered product presentation; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为单张详情长图，按 7 屏内容板块逐屏提炼（原 4 片粗切重切为 7 屏，与 7 个分镜一一对应）。纠正：源文件夹名为维生素C，但图内产品信息实为成人复合维生素软糖（成分含B3/B6/B12/C/D/E），故按实际内容归类为医药保健/营养补充/复合维生素软糖，与库内维生素C泡腾片以剂型（软糖vs泡腾片）和配方（复合vs单一）区分。已剥离：图库品牌水印字样、英文水印名、二维码会员标、门店角标及全部功效原文（增强免疫等声称均转为 {callout}/{selling_point} 槽位）。假设：软糖形态依据产品名称推断（源图未开瓶展示），shot-05微距中的软糖质感按剂型合理演绎。备注：原五色板收敛为四色，叶绿 #A8C948 保留为图标点缀色写入锁定文案。
